collections.name: Pricing questions
collections.description: Plans, seats, billing and what happens when you change your mind.

pages.title: Is there a free plan?
pages.markdown: Yes. The Free plan is free forever for up to three members, with every core feature. You only pay when your team grows or you need admin controls.

pages.title: What counts as a member?
pages.markdown: Anyone who can sign in to your workspace. Guests you invite to a single project are free and do not count toward your plan.

pages.title: Can I change plans at any time?
pages.markdown: Yes. Upgrades apply immediately and are prorated to the day. Downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing period, so you never lose time you have paid for.

pages.title: Do you offer a discount for paying yearly?
pages.markdown: Paying yearly costs the same as ten months — two months free — on every paid plan.

pages.title: Do you have discounts for non-profits and education?
pages.markdown: Yes. Registered non-profits and schools get 50% off any paid plan. Write to us from your organisation’s address and we will apply it to your workspace.

pages.title: Which payment methods do you accept?
pages.markdown: All major cards on every plan. Yearly Enterprise plans can also pay by invoice and bank transfer.

pages.title: What happens to my data if I cancel?
pages.markdown: Your workspace becomes read-only on the Free plan’s limits. Nothing is deleted, and you can export everything or upgrade again whenever you like.
